exposure: 10 mutually exclusive groups derived from the Robson caesarean section classification
cohort: Women with live births of ≥24 weeks gestation in New South Wales, Australia, 2010-2011
finding: Significant variation in IOL rates (9.7% to 41.2%) exists between hospitals, even after adjusting for case-mix, particularly for nulliparous and multiparous women at 39-40 weeks gestation with a singleton cephalic birth.
